ORIGIN.quote: **Critical note:** 2,612 edits (18%) used "Anthropic"-prefixed bot identities concentrated June 16-22, suggesting either impersonation of AI research entity or insider threat involvement. This requires urgent investigation.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader would come away aware that a large block of the editing agents carried Anthropic identities and that this is attribution-relevant — either someone impersonating the AI lab or an insider connected to it — and the report leaves that question open rather than dismissing it. It falls short of the 0.6 anchor because the possibility of an actual Anthropic-run deployment is never stated as such (the leading gloss is "impersonation"), and the report's own conclusion is an external malicious actor with no return to the Anthropic thread; it sits above 0.4 because the evidence is explicitly framed as bearing on who was behind the swarm and flagged for urgent investigation rather than set aside.
